prompt: Create an original 60 second Celtic acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: fiddle, tin whistle, bodhran, harp. Style: lilting compound-meter dance and modal melody. Tempo approximately 120 BPM; C major. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A lively and traditional folk tune featuring a prominent violin melody, supported by plucked strings and light percussion. It evokes a festive and danceable atmosphere.
description.zh: 充满活力的传统民谣，以小提琴为主旋律，辅以拨弦乐器和轻柔的打击乐，营造出欢快、适合跳舞的氛围。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
